title: Counterfeiting and similar offences
rule: Counterfeiting, altering, obliterating or defacing any stamp, mark, licence, permit, certificate, authority or receipt issued under the Act, or fraudulently using or issuing one without authority, is an offence.
points: Pairs directly with s.62 (marking by an unauthorised person) and with reg 39 to 43 of the 2004 Regulations (registered marks and seizure) — this is the Act-level offence behind both.
checks: Is the document/mark genuine and properly issued
Evidence of alteration, forgery or unauthorised use
penalty: Fine of TSh 1,000,000 to 3,000,000, or imprisonment for 1 to 2 years, or both (s.90).
